sentences.text: Oriental Insurance Company vs . Anita Rani And on 8 July, 2025

Author: Vivek Singh Thakur
Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Oriental Insurance Company vs. Anita Rani and others .
Fao (Mva) No. 73 of 2020 08.07.2025 Present: Dr.Lalit K. Sharma, Advocate, for the appellant.

Mr.Ashwani Kaundal, Advocate, for respondents No.1 to 4.
None for respondent No.5.

Mr.Abhishek, Advocate, vice Ms.Rachna Kuthiala, Advocate, for respondent No.6.
Fao (Mva) No. 73 of 2020

After service of respondent No.5, Mr.Ashok K. Thakur, Advocate, had put in appearance on 02.09.2020 and, as prayed by him, time was granted to file Power of Attorney,
but till date no Power of Attorney has been filed.

However, instead of passing any adverse order, by taking a lenient view, respondent No.5 is not proceeded ex parte, and in case Power of Attorney is not filed on his behalf within four weeks, adverse order shall follow.
This application has been filed on behalf of applicant-respondent No.1 for release of 50% of amount of compensation awarded in her favour.

Release of 50% amount has been opposed by appellant-Insurance Company, on the ground that there is every likelihood of reduction thereof, and in case of release of 50% of amount, it would be difficult for the Insurance Company to recover the same from the applicant.

It has been submitted on behalf of applicant- respondent No.1 that claimant is agitating for just and fair compensation since long and till date she has not received the .
same.

Balancing the interest and considering submissions, at this stage, 25% of amount of compensation falling in share of applicant-respondent No.1 alongwith proportionate interest is ordered to be released in her favour, by remitting the same in her bank account mentioned in paragraph 2 of the application, photocopy of front page of Pass Book whereof has been annexed with this application.

r The aforesaid release shall be subject to final order passed in the main appeal, and in case it is found in future that excess amount has been released then, applicant shall be liable to refund the Oriental Insurance Company vs .
